zh-CN.page_title: option-berth · 多份代码，各自成泊
zh-CN.description: 面向开发者与 coding agent 的本地 worktree 工作台。在原生 macOS 客户端中管理项目服务、只读 Git、终端与外部 Agent 会话。
zh-CN.eyebrow: 本地优先 · 原生 macOS · 开源
zh-CN.hero_description: 为并行开发留一个清楚的工作台。每份 worktree 的服务、Git、终端与 Agent 会话，各归其位。少猜一次状态，多专注一段代码。
zh-CN.workspace_title: 一份代码，一个清楚的上下文。
zh-CN.services_alt: option-berth 原生服务页：隔离演示项目的 API 与 worker 运行状态、端口和日志。
zh-CN.git_alt: option-berth 原生 Git 页：演示分支中的已修改文件和只读差异。
zh-CN.terminal_alt: option-berth 原生终端工作区：同一 worktree 的两个真实 zsh 会话分屏显示，输入互不广播。
zh-CN.screenshots_note: 真实 macOS 窗口截图，使用隔离演示项目。点击图片查看原图。
zh-CN.value_one_body: 清单说该跑什么，运行记录和实际观察说现在怎样。服务、端口、退出与日志不再靠猜。
zh-CN.value_two_body: 每个会话固定在创建时的 worktree。切换代码目录，不会悄悄迁移已有终端或混淆项目服务。
zh-CN.value_three_body: 原生终端承载你的 shell 与 coding agent。不用迁移到另一套聊天系统，也不必引入云端工作区。
zh-CN.workflow_title: 从一份清单开始，不从一堆配置开始。
zh-CN.workflow_intro: 客户端和 CLI 共用一条运行事实链。你做明确的选择，option-berth 把状态和下一步放在眼前。
zh-CN.step_one_body: 选择代码目录。已有清单直接读取；新清单先审阅，再由你确认写入。Agent 可以起草，不能代替你采纳。
zh-CN.step_two_body: 按依赖启动声明的项目服务，核对实际运行与就绪情况。机器级依赖只读，不会被顺手停止。
zh-CN.step_three_body: 从服务进入日志，从 Git 查看改动，从终端继续工作。结束时只停当前项目，不动另一份 worktree。
zh-CN.guide_alt: option-berth 原生首次使用指引的第二步：接入 worktree 并由人审阅清单。
zh-CN.guide_caption: 可跳过、可重开。读完指引不等于环境验证通过。
zh-CN.console_intro: 把终端和 Agent 会话放在同一份代码旁边，但不接管工具自己的判断、登录和审批。
zh-CN.handoff_title: 交给 Agent，再回到原生会话
zh-CN.handoff_body: 首条消息用于创建新的外部 Agent 会话；后续对话在它自己的原生终端中继续。普通 Enter 仍然换行。
zh-CN.agents_body: 自行安装并登录所需工具。客户端提供显式启动与支持范围内的续接，不自动安装、不绕过审批。
zh-CN.history_body: 在同一 worktree 的多个终端间搜索命令与会话。保留明确的退出结果，复制字面命令，不替你执行。清空前再确认一次。
zh-CN.history_note: zsh 命令块需事先启用。历史只在内存中，关闭会话或退出应用即丢弃；不导入 shell 历史文件。
zh-CN.history_alt: option-berth 原生命令历史窗口，展示同一演示 worktree 两个 zsh 会话实际执行的命令、退出结果和复制入口。
zh-CN.principles_intro: option-berth 是本地开发工作台，不是新的 Agent 平台。每一种状态、权限和副作用，都有自己的归属。
zh-CN.principle_one_title: 本地事实，不是模型推断
zh-CN.principle_one_body: 声明、运行与观察来自代码。失败和未知不会被包装成成功；停止请求不被当成退出证明。
zh-CN.principle_two_body: 产品的 Git 功能只读，清单由人确认。外部 shell 和 Agent 保留自己的权限，worktree 不是系统沙箱。
zh-CN.principle_three_title: 恢复有选择，隐私有分寸
zh-CN.principle_three_body: 布局恢复需明确同意，只保存必要元数据，不保存消息、输出或 PID，也不自动复活进程。没有云端同步。
zh-CN.download_title: 给下一份代码，一个泊位。
zh-CN.download_description: 原生 macOS 客户端，配套同版本 oberth 引擎。也可单独使用 CLI，接入你自己的开发流程。
zh-CN.trust_note: macOS 应用包面向 Apple Silicon，要求 macOS 14+。当前采用 ad-hoc 签名，尚无 Developer ID 签名或 Apple 公证。
zh-CN.install_answer: 从官方 GitHub Release 获取安装包并核对 SHA256SUMS。macOS 包包含匹配版本的引擎；不要把 ad-hoc 签名当作 Apple 信任或公证。安装与升级由你明确执行，应用不会自动替换或停止已有服务。Windows/Linux 提供 CLI 包，不提供桌面客户端。
zh-CN.footer_line: 本地优先，边界清楚。让代码各自成泊。

en.page_title: option-berth · Every worktree, in its own berth
en.description: A local worktree workspace for developers and coding agents. Project services, read-only Git, native terminals and external agent sessions in one macOS app.
en.eyebrow: Local first · Native macOS · Open source
en.hero_description: A clearer place for parallel development. Keep each worktree’s services, Git context, terminals and agent sessions together. Less guessing. More time with your code.
en.services_alt: Native option-berth services view with a real isolated demo API and worker, their runtime state, port and logs.
en.git_alt: Native option-berth Git view with changed files and a read-only diff in the demo branch.
en.terminal_alt: Native option-berth workspace with two real zsh sessions in a split layout, scoped to the same worktree without broadcasting input.
en.screenshots_note: Actual macOS windows, captured with an isolated demo project. Select an image to see the original.
en.value_one_body: Your manifest says what should run. Run records and observations show what does. Trace services, ports, exits and logs without guesswork.
en.value_two_body: Every session keeps its starting worktree. Switching checkouts never silently moves a terminal or mixes up project services.
en.value_three_body: A native terminal hosts your shell and existing coding agents. No new chat system to migrate to. No cloud workspace required.
en.workflow_title: Start with a manifest. Not a maze.
en.workflow_intro: The app and CLI share one chain of runtime facts. You make the decisions; option-berth keeps the state and next step in view.
en.step_one_body: Choose a code directory. Read an existing manifest, or review and accept a new one. An agent can draft it, but the final choice is yours.
en.step_two_body: Start declared services in dependency order and check their actual runtime and readiness. Machine dependencies remain read-only.
en.step_three_body: Open logs from a service, inspect a Git diff, or continue in a terminal. Stop this project when you are done, without touching another worktree.
en.guide_alt: Native option-berth getting-started guide, explaining how to connect a worktree and explicitly review its manifest.
en.guide_caption: Skip it. Reopen it. Reading is not a readiness check.
en.console_intro: Keep terminal and agent sessions beside the code they work on, without taking over their reasoning, authentication or approvals.
en.handoff_title: A prompt, then a native handoff
en.handoff_body: Use the first message to start an external agent session. Continue the conversation in its own native terminal. Return still inserts a newline.
en.agents_body: Install and authenticate the tools you need. Launch explicitly and resume where supported. No automatic installs or approval bypasses.
en.history_title: Find the command. Keep your flow.
en.history_body: Search commands and session names across this worktree’s terminals. Keep exit results explicit. Copy the literal command without executing it. Confirm before clearing.
en.history_note: Enable zsh command blocks beforehand. History lives in memory and is discarded when a session closes or the app quits. Shell-history files are not imported.
en.history_alt: Native command-history window showing commands actually run by two zsh sessions in the same demo worktree, with exit results and copy controls.
en.principles_title: Less to take over. More to trust.
en.principles_intro: A local development workspace, not another agent platform. Each state, permission and side effect has a clear owner.
en.principle_one_body: Declarations, runs and observations come from code. Unknown is not success. A stop request is not proof of an exit.
en.principle_two_body: Product Git actions are read-only; manifests need your approval. External shells and agents keep their own permissions. A worktree is not an OS sandbox.
en.principle_three_body: Opt in to saving essential layout metadata, not prompts, output or PIDs. Restoring a layout never resurrects a process. No cloud sync.
en.download_title: A berth for your next checkout.
en.download_description: A native macOS app with its matching oberth engine. Or use the CLI on its own, inside the workflow you already have.
en.trust_note: The macOS app requires Apple Silicon and macOS 14+. Current builds are ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or Apple notarized.
en.install_question: What should I know before installing?
en.install_answer: Get packages from the official GitHub Release and check SHA256SUMS. The macOS package includes its matching engine. Ad-hoc signing is not Apple trust or notarization. Installation and upgrades are explicit; the app does not replace itself or stop your existing services. Windows and Linux packages are CLI-only, not desktop apps.
en.footer_line: Local first. Clear boundaries. A place for every worktree.
